subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards add a default-off append/delta payload escape hatch, or should OpenClaw continue to require full-content CardKit updates and pursue a different latency strategy?
rationale: The official CardKit contract favors full text, earlier reports needed full text to avoid truncation, but the latest live repro says full-content updates still create multi-minute tails and the coalescing-only PR did not solve it.

options.title: Add Opt-In Payload Escape Hatch
options.body: Keep full-content as the default but allow a documented per-account opt-in append/delta or equivalent transport mode only after live proof shows improved latency without truncation.

options.title: Stay Full-Content Only
options.body: Reject append/delta modes and require another Feishu-supported strategy, accepting that affected deployments may need streaming disabled until that strategy is proven.

options.title: Land Cadence Coalescing Anyway
options.body: Proceed with the open coalescing PR despite the latest live report that it did not noticeably improve the multi-minute tail.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Payload Escape Hatch
recommendation.body: Keep full-content as the default but allow a documented per-account opt-in append/delta or equivalent transport mode only after live proof shows improved latency without truncation.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names @m1heng as the Feishu plugin maintainer contact, and the choice is specific to Feishu channel behavior and config surface.
